query: SELECT npc_round.id, npc_round.root_sequence_id, npc_round.group_id, npc_round.state, npc_round.scene_revision, "group".scene_revision AS current_revision FROM npc_round JOIN "group" ON "group".id = npc_round.group_id JOIN npc_discussion ON npc_discussion.root_sequence_id = npc_round.root_sequence_id WHERE "group".world_id = ? AND "group".retired_at IS NULL AND npc_round.state IN ('collecting', 'selected') AND npc_discussion.state = 'ready'                AND (npc_round.state = 'selected' OR NOT EXISTS (                    SELECT 1 FROM npc_round AS earlier                    WHERE earlier.group_id = npc_round.group_id                      AND earlier.state IN ('selected', 'executing'))) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM npc_round_source JOIN action ON action.requesting_tool_execution_id = npc_round_source.source_tool_execution_id JOIN speech ON speech.action_id = action.id JOIN speech_batch ON speech_batch.id = speech.batch_id JOIN sequence ON sequence.id = speech_batch.sequence_id WHERE npc_round_source.round_id = npc_round.id AND (sequence.finished_at IS NULL OR sequence.error IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY npc_round.id LIMIT 1
